one_line: Clevis pin with a cross hole and h11 shaft
function: Serves as a pivotal hinge pin in a clevis joint assembly. Holds linked parts together with a retaining split pin through the cross hole.

features.value: Diameter 3.2 mm through, 7 mm from end

manufacturing: Maintain shaft precision to h11 tolerance class during turning.
Drill ⌀3.2 mm cross hole accurately 7 mm from the end.
Apply general tolerances per KS B ISO 2768-m.
uncertain: Specific surface roughness requirements are not provided.
